parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: A client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. The client generates this value to make sure that the value is unique among different requests. The token is case-sensitive and cannot exceed 64 ASCII characters in length.

parameters.name: DBClusterId
parameters.description:
The ID of the Data Warehouse Edition cluster.

> Call the [DescribeDBClusters](~~129857~~) operation to query the IDs of all Data Warehouse Edition clusters in the destination region.

parameters.name: GroupName
parameters.description: The name of the resource group.
